act.name: Special Marriage Act, 1954
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law for civil marriage, registration, matrimonial relief, divorce and related procedure.

sections.title: Conditions relating to solemnization of special marriages.
sections.text: Section 4 states the statutory conditions for solemnizing a marriage under the Special Marriage Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Sets the eligibility conditions for a civil marriage under the Act.

sections.title: Divorce.
sections.text: Section 27 sets out grounds for divorce in marriages solemnized under the Special Marriage Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Lists grounds for divorce in a civil or interfaith marriage registered under this Act.

sections.title: Divorce by mutual consent.
sections.text: Section 28 provides for divorce by mutual consent under the Special Marriage Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Spouses married under this Act may jointly seek divorce when the statutory conditions are met.

sections.title: Alimony pendente lite.
sections.text: Section 36 provides for interim alimony during proceedings under the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Provides temporary financial support during pending matrimonial proceedings.

sections.title: Permanent alimony and maintenance.
sections.text: Section 37 provides for permanent alimony and maintenance after matrimonial relief.
sections.plain_language_summary: Allows the court to grant long-term or lump-sum maintenance in appropriate cases.
